[short] skip 'cross-links the standard library for aix'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=aix
env GOARCH=ppc64
env CGO_ENABLED=0
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd a/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/aixa ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''syscall\.Syscall'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''syscall\.Syscall'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''syscall\.Syscall6'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''syscall\.RawSyscall'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/adep'' reaches ''syscall\.RawSyscall6'''
cd ../..

cd b/main
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/aixb ./cmd
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep'' reaches ''syscall\.syscall6'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_net\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep'' reaches ''syscall\.syscall6'''
stderr 'ERROR \[capabilities::unauthorized_exec\]: Transitive dependency ''example\.com/bdep'' reaches ''syscall\.rawSyscall6'''
cd ../..

-- a/main/go.mod --
module example.com/amain

go 1.27

require example.com/adep v0.0.0

replace example.com/adep => ../dep

-- a/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- a/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/adep"

func main() { adep.Init() }

-- a/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/adep

go 1.27

-- a/dep/dep.go --
package adep

import "syscall"

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	syscall.Syscall(0, 0, 0, 0)
	syscall.Syscall6(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	syscall.RawSyscall(0, 0, 0, 0)
	syscall.RawSyscall6(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
}

-- b/main/go.mod --
module example.com/bmain

go 1.27

require example.com/bdep v0.0.0

replace example.com/bdep => ../dep

-- b/main/logos.toml --
[capabilities]
transitive_unsafe = "allow"
transitive_exec = "deny"
transitive_net = "deny"

-- b/main/cmd/main.go --
package main

import "example.com/bdep"

func main() { bdep.Init() }

-- b/dep/go.mod --
module example.com/bdep

go 1.27

-- b/dep/empty.s --
-- b/dep/dep.go --
package bdep

import (
	_ "syscall"
	_ "unsafe"
)

//go:linkname libcSyscall6 syscall.syscall6
func libcSyscall6(trap, nargs, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6 uintptr) (r1, r2, err uintptr)

//go:linkname libcRawSyscall6 syscall.rawSyscall6
func libcRawSyscall6(trap, nargs, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6 uintptr) (r1, r2, err uintptr)

//go:noinline
func Init() {
	libcSyscall6(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
	libcRawSyscall6(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)
}
